hooks.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.gemini/config/scripts/notify_user.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.gemini/config/scripts/notify_user.sh" question; elif [ -x "./scripts/notify_user.sh" ]; then "./scripts/notify_user.sh" question; else ./.agents/scripts/notify_user.sh question; fi
